proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b p
  have e1 : p - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (a + b) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((p - a) + (p - b)) := by module
  have e2 : a - b = (p - b) - (p - a) := by abel
  rw [e1, e2, norm_smul, norm_sub_rev (p - b) (p - a), Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num)]
  have hsq : ‖(p - a) + (p - b)‖ ^ 2 - ‖(p - a) - (p - b)‖ ^ 2 = 4 * inner ℝ (p - a) (p - b) := by
    rw [norm_add_sq_real (p - a) (p - b), norm_sub_sq_real (p - a) (p - b)]; ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : ‖(p - a) + (p - b)‖ ^ 2 = ‖(p - a) - (p - b)‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h] at hsq; linarith
    have := (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp h'
    rw [this]; ring
  · intro h
    have h' : ‖(p - a) + (p - b)‖ = ‖(p - a) - (p - b)‖ := by linarith
    rw [h'] at hsq
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b p : V), inner ℝ (p - a) (p - b) = 0 ↔ ‖p - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (a + b)‖ = ‖a - b‖ / 2
